facts.fact: ITWeb reports that Cape Town venture firm Havaic invested $1 million each in SAPay and Sportable in mid-2025, from its African Innovation Fund 3, whose second close secured $25 million of commitments.
ITWeb reports that Havaic's second close of $25 million came with commitments from South African investors Sanlam Multi-Manager, the SA SME Fund and Fireball Capital, with no split of amounts given.
